subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw core add and support the `agent:turn:transcript:save` ACP hook contract, including saved/skipped/failed semantics and the awaited save-callback ordering in ACP turn completion?
rationale: Source review can show the implementation shape, but it cannot decide whether this new internal hook/API and session-state ordering should become a supported OpenClaw contract.

options.title: Close unless sponsored
options.body: If no owner accepts the hook contract, close this PR and keep broader lifecycle-hook direction in the canonical design discussion.

options.title: Sponsor and refresh
options.body: Accept the hook contract, then require the contributor to resolve conflicts and rerun current-head ACP transcript-save proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle design
options.body: Keep the idea but replace this split PR with a broader lifecycle-hook design that covers transcript-save and turn-end consistently.

recommendation.title: Close unless sponsored
recommendation.body: If no owner accepts the hook contract, close this PR and keep broader lifecycle-hook direction in the canonical design discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the internal hook contract boundary, and history links steipete to the original hook system and adjacent transcript helper surfaces.
